basis: The public municipal parcel service returns full geometry, but an independently fetched native EPSG:2177 parcel (OBJECTID 1150; ID_SWDE 026401_1.0001.1434) is invalid: Ring Self-intersection[6431379.179 5663867.811]. Original source rings remain unmodified; no repair, filtering or replacement was used. Runtime is held for native geometry invalidity; local public geometry remains verified. This one native conflict is sufficient to reject the current runtime candidate and does not describe citywide prevalence.
